cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
h=open('props2.html').read()
anchors=[]
for m in re.finditer(r'<a\b[^>]*>', h):
    t=m.group(0)
    href=re.search(r'href="([^"]*)"', t)
    if href and ('button' in t or 'new' in href.group(1).lower()):
        anchors.append((href.group(1), t[:120]))
seen=set()
for a,t in anchors:
    if a not in seen:
        seen.add(a); print(a)
EOF
